resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS gives 1938. Firelookout.com, the Biennial Report entry quoted on washingtonlookouts, and Willhite give 1937. The story uses 1937 and says the register differs.
FFLOS and firelookout.com give 99 feet; Willhite and the Biennial Report entry give 100 feet; the 1946-47 USGS survey described 103 feet to the cab floor. Record height kept at 30.5 m (100 ft).

FFLOS says the U.S. Forest Service administers the site; firelookout.com and Willhite credit the state forestry division with building it. The story reports the construction credit only; the Forest Service administration is left out.
Willhite dates the panorama photos to July 16, 1941; washingtonlookouts gives January 16, 1941. Not used in the story.

notes_for_editor: Corrections: none needed; the brief's agency and height match the sources, though sources conflict on both (see resolved_conflicts). Access level left out: Willhite describes road conditions and a likely DNR easement but no published access rule. Ground house status comes from Willhite's 2021 note and may be out of date. No source describes what remains of the tower footings. Not visited by this run.
